issue.body:
From what I can see in the docs, the `url_for` method is only provided as part of an incoming `Request` object. This means that tests need to either create their own lookup mechanism or hard-code the urls they're working with.

It would be great if there was a way to use url reversing in tests in order to both support easier creation of placeholdered urls as well as avoiding needing to hard-code urls in tests.
issue.title: How to use url_for in tests
